name: DREAM
author: Seth Graves
tagline: Sine tones in just intonation, held. After La Monte Young and Marian Zazeela.
description: A tribute to La Monte Young: pure sine tones tuned in whole-number ratios and held, phase-locked, for as long as the FM-1 is on. Pieces after Composition 1960 No. 7, the Dream House (with its eight bases), the Well-Tuned Piano's Opening and Magic Chords and its tuning, a drift study and Map of 49's Dream (the last two in tones chosen by his stated rules; his own are unpublished). Density, drift and a slowly breathing density. No effects, no samples.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
